description:
**Company Description** 
 SculptSoft is an AI software development company that turns ambitious ideas into intelligent, scalable, and future\-ready digital products. With over 13 years of experience, the company specializes in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, automation, and full\-cycle product development, helping clients streamline operations and make better data\-driven decisions. SculptSoft serves startups and enterprises across diverse sectors such as healthcare, fintech, education, real estate, e\-commerce, manufacturing, and more.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Software Engineering Manager will lead a team of software engineers to design, develop, and deliver high\-quality AI\-driven and cloud\-based solutions aligned with client and product requirements. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Ahmedabad and involves overseeing end\-to\-end project execution, from technical planning and architecture reviews to code quality, performance optimization, and release management.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Software Development and Software Design, including experience with modern programming languages, architectures, and design patterns.
* Candidates should possess proven Team Leadership capabilities, including mentoring, performance management, and building inclusive, collaborative engineering teams.
* Candidates should possess solid Project Management experience, including planning, estimation, risk management, and delivery within agile or similar methodologies.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Distributed Systems, including scalable microservices, cloud\-native architectures, and high\-availability solutions.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with AI/ML, data platforms, or cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical decisions with business goals.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad and collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional teams.
